recovery.detail: Inactive editor preserves completed folder steps, refreshes dependent fences and exposes partial success without replaying folders. Storage failures carry captured request identity and persistence phase; only the matching pending/completion barrier refuses. Superseded failures and removal failures cannot undo observation. Recovery effects return to the scoped host executor.
